comment: The look of every menu, panel, and label, and the colors of the health bar and the hit flash of the battle screen (D-527, D-826, D-829). Game builds the Godot Theme from this file at load, and no theme resource file exists (G-6). Each color names a palette key of content/sprites/palette.json, so the screen keeps one palette (D-89, D-181). The player picks the body size, and the title is title_scale times the body (D-707).
